Dialogs.Dialog: Good morning！ We meet again today！
I was just thinking I wanted to talk with you, hehe.
Ah, okay. It's all right. Let's talk.
I'll try to stay awake so I can talk with you▼
It's night already, but want to talk？
I'm sleepy. But if you want to talk, okay.
Good morning. Let's do our best today.
You just woke up？ It's already noon.
Oh my. You just woke up at this hour？
It's night, you know？ Did your sleep schedule get flipped？
Did you wake up because you couldn't sleep？
Good morning. You're an early riser. Do you have anything going on today？
Eh？ You're going to sleep now？
If you sleep now, you won't be able to sleep tonight, you know？
Good night. Have a nice dream, okay？
Good night. You go to bed late, huh.
Finally going to bed？ Will you be able to get up？
Do you have anything to ask me？
Is there something on my face？
...What？ If you look at me like that, I'll get embarrassed, you know？
Looking forward to our next date？
Yes. Let's make it a wonderful date together.
Our last date was fun, wasn't it？
You thought so too？ I want another date like that next time.
Hmm, I feel so silly, like it was just me.
Thank you for the present. I was so happy.
Having someone to give presents to and get them from is happiness, isn't it.
Huh, what？ I was thanking you for the present...
Hey, who were you just thinking about？
What's wrong？ Didn't you hear me？
Valentine's is coming up. Looking forward to it？ Hehe.
Hmm, what should I do？ Just kidding.
Christmas is coming soon, right？ Plans with your girlfriend？ Just kidding.
Hehe▼ I wish Christmas would hurry up.
Geez. I'm looking forward to it, you know.
Our anniversary's coming up. Did you remember？
Your birthday's coming up. Looking forward to it？
Manaka's birthday is coming up soon. Did you remember？
Then maybe I can look forward to something. Just kidding.
This year's almost over. Was it a good year？
For me too. Because you were here.
The new term starts soon. Can't wait？
Hehe, we get to be together at school too.
Hehe, really？ Maybe your homework isn't done.
Tests are coming up. Are you studying？
Geez... No good. Get serious. Okay？
Spring's almost here. Do you like spring？
Yes, let's go see the cherry blossoms.
Summer's almost here. Do you like summer？
I see. You don't like the heat？
Fall's almost here. Do you like fall？
Fall for art, fall for books... fall for sweet potatoes. Hehe♪
It's the season when you miss people, right？ But Manaka's here with you？
Winter's almost here. Do you like winter？
Christmas, and Valentine's. The season for lovers... Just kidding.
You're not good with the cold？
It's not that bad, you know？
Hey, tell me your favorite color？
I see. Okay, I'll remember that.
You like an unusual color, huh.
Hey, hey, tell me your favorite food？
Hehe, me too. It's so good, right？
Really...？ I'm not so good with that.
I see. I don't think I've ever had it.
Hey, which of my outfits do you like？
Okay. I'll remember. But don't expect too much？
No. That's definitely meant in a pervy way...
I see. Then maybe I'll use that as a reference.
Hey, what kind of movies do you like again？
Hmm, I might not like those.
Hmm, I don't think I've seen any.
What kind of shows at the event hall do you like？
Yes, sounds nice. Let's go together, okay？
I see... Hmm, I'll give it a try.
Huh. They have that kind of thing？
What kind of place do you like for dates？
Yes, me too. Let's go together.
Hmm, if you like it, then okay.
I see. Anywhere's fine with you, though... Just kidding.
Hey, if I were an animal, what would I be？
Hehe, I'm happy. I love bunnies▼
Um. Do you have a favorite shop？
Oh, I like it too！ Shall we go now？ Hehe♪
I see. I don't really know it, so take me sometime？
Hey, hey... Do you love me？
Yes, hehe. Sometimes I just want to hear it.
How embarrassing. ...I love you so much too▼
Hey... What do you love about me？
Hmm. Hehe, that's a little embarrassing.
Hmm, I don't really get it.
Um, when we kiss, don't you mind people seeing？
Let's do lots of things together from now on, okay？
I don't really get it, but... okay.
I put you on the spot. ...Hehe♪
Do you have a dream for the future？
Yes, I hope it comes true. When it does, I want to be by your side.
I see... Then share mine？ Okay？
Your first love... could it be... me？ Just kidding...
I'm happy. ...Then we're the same？ Hehe.
Hmm... Not that I care, though？
Hey, do you remember when we first met？
Yes. Me too. I'm sure I'll never forget it.
Liar. You're teasing me, aren't you？
Do you remember our first date？
Me too. I remember my heart pounding so hard my chest hurt.
Um. Do you remember when I confessed to you？
I love you more than back then. Just saying.
Geez, asking that now isn't fair.
You already know... I love you▼
I love you. So much... I love you.
Hmm. I like warm colors, like red and yellow.
Let's see. I like calm colors, like blue.
I like places where I can look at clothes, I guess.
I might like shops with cute accessories.
Cute clothes. That's someone's fault. Hehe.
Calm, neat and graceful, I guess... Plain？
Simple, casual stuff. I have to be more outgoing.
We talked so much today. Hehe♪
I'm happy we could talk about so much today.
We didn't get to talk much today. Next time, okay？
Okay. Then make sure you get up？
Wake up, please！ It's time！ Come on, you can do it！
Wake up, it's time. ...Hey, wake up？ Please？
I'm sorry！ I forgot the time I was supposed to wake you！
Oh, you're up▼ Hehe, good morning.
Geez, this is the last time, okay？ Wake uuup！
Okay, I'll tell you when it's time. Hehe, leave it to me.
It's time！ Hehe, is this okay？
Oh no... I might've missed the time a little！
It's time, come quick▼ You know what for, right？
Hehe. Don't you have plans？ Just saying.
Hey, hey, want to play rock-paper-scissors？ Best of three. If you win, you get a reward？ Okay？
Start with rock... Rock, paper, scissors...
Hm？ Hmm, that one doesn't count！
Yay, Manaka wins！ What should I have you do？ Just kidding♪
Aww, I lost. Then, as promised, your reward.
It's dark out, right？ It's night.
It's the middle of the night. Geez, at this hour...
Manaka Takane announces: it's midnight. Just kidding.
It's 3 A.M. Let's go to sleep？ Okay？
It's 8. Let's do our best today too！
It's 9. Hmm？ Are you properly awake？
It's noon！ What should we eat today？ Hehe♪
It's 1 P.M. Let's do our best this afternoon too！
It's 4. Almost there, hang in there！
It's 5. Time to head home soon？
It's 6. Any plans after this？ Hehe.
It's 7. What are you doing for dinner？
It's 9. Maybe I'll go to bed soon...
It's 10, you know？ Let's go to sleep？
One more hour and today's over. Good work today.
